commit.message:
docs: credit NotRexed for Hookshot, and README.md, docs/BAKE.md, no changelog.txt

The rename to Longshot also rewrote NotRexed's credit ("NotRexed: Longshot") and
parts of the project's history. Longshot is a fork of Hookshot, so say so.

- README: Longshot is a fork of NotRexed's Hookshot (top and Credits); NotRexed
  is credited for Hookshot; EvilOOT's link back to evilmfkr/Hookshot; the License
  section names Hookshot's copyright next to the Longshot contributors'.
- History back to Hookshot: CHANGELOG.md's four renamed entries and a note that
  the entries up to 2.2.0-rc.1 are Hookshot's; TomShafford/Hookshot (a Hookshot
  fork) in oot_heap_retry; the PROVENANCE notes; measured runs of Hookshot builds
  in docs/cpu-profile.md and docs/saves.md; the Fritchii recipe's note.
- readme.md is README.md, BAKE.md is docs/BAKE.md, with every reference.
- changelog.txt is gone: Hookshot's 0.1.0 changelog is linked in its repository.
